ayahOccurrences.text: ثُمَّ قَسَتْ قُلُوبُكُم مِّنۢ بَعْدِ ذَٰلِكَ فَهِىَ كَٱلْحِجَارَةِ أَوْ أَشَدُّ قَسْوَةً ۚ وَإِنَّ مِنَ ٱلْحِجَارَةِ لَمَا يَتَفَجَّرُ مِنْهُ ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ ۚ وَإِنَّ مِنْهَا لَمَا يَشَّقَّقُ فَيَخْرُجُ مِنْهُ ٱلْمَآءُ ۚ وَإِنَّ مِنْهَا لَمَا يَهْبِطُ مِنْ خَشْيَةِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَمَا ٱللَّهُ بِغَٰفِلٍ عَمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ

lexSnapshot.wordGrammar: 3rd person masculine singular (form V) imperfect verb
lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: يَشَّقَّقُ is in the derivative form: يَتَشَقَّق
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ش/ق/ق   sh–q–q to split, to cleave, to slit, to rent, to rip
; fissure, crack; to come forth; to effect disunion, to act contrarily, dispute; hardship, difficulty, distress, to burden.

Of this root, 9 forms occur 28 times in the Qur’an:
شَقَّ shaqqa 2 times; شاقَّ shāqqa 7 times; يَتَشَقَّق yatashaqqaq 3 times; إنشَقَّ ʾinshaqqa 5 times; شَقّ shaqq 1 time; شِقّ shiqq 1 time; شُقَّة shuqqatun 1 time; أَشَقّ ʾashaqq 1 time and شِقاق shiqāq 7 times.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
يَتَشَقَّق yatashaqqaq (also assimilated form يَشَّقَّقُ yashshaqqaq) [imperf. of v. V, intrans.] to split open, to crack, to cleave asunder

(2:74) وَإِنَّ مِنْهَا لَمَا يَشَّقَّقُ فَيَخْرُجُ مِنْهُ الْمَاءُ and some of them split open so that water comes out of them.

entries.definitionHtml:
يَتَشَقَّق yatashaqqaq (also assimilated form يَشَّقَّقُ yashshaqqaq) [imperf. of v. V, intrans.] to split open, to crack, to cleave asunder

entries.label: أشَقّ
entries.definitionHtml:
أشَقّ ʾashaqq [elat.] harder, more difficult

(13:34) وَلَعَذَابُ الآخِرَةِ أَشَقُّ but surely the punishment of the Hereafter is harder.

entries.label: إنشَقَّ
entries.definitionHtml:
إنشَقَّ ʾinshaqqa [v. VII, intrans.] to split up, to crack

(54:1) اقْتَرَبَتِ السَّاعَةُ وَانْشَقَّ الْقَمَرُ the Hour draws near and the moon is split in two.

entries.label: شاقّ
entries.definitionHtml:
شاقّ shāqqa [v. III, trans.] to dispute rebelliously with, to argue in an antagonistic fashion, to cause/create dispute with

(4:115) وَمَنْ يُشَاقِقِ الرَّسُولَ مِنْ بَعْدِ مَا تَبَيَّنَ لَهُ الْهُدَى and whoever creates dispute with the Messenger, after the guidance has become clear to him.

entries.label: شَقّ
entries.definitionHtml:
شَقّ shaqq [v. n., used emphatically] fissuring, cracking, splitting up, breaking asunder

(80:26) ثُمَّ شَقَقْنَا الأَرْضَ شَقًّا then We split the earth asunder.

entries.label: شَقَّ
entries.definitionHtml:
شَقَّ shaqqa u I [v. intrans. with prep. عَلى] to cause hardship to, to place difficulty on

(28:27) وَمَا أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَشُقَّ عَلَيْكَ for I do not wish to place hardship on you II [v. trans.] to split, to cleave

(80:26) ثُمَّ شَقَقْنَا الأَرْضَ شَقًّا then We split the earth asunder.

entries.label: شُقَّة
entries.definitionHtml:
شُقَّة shuqqatun [n.] region, tract, quarter (towards which one travels), difficult journey, distance, trouble, toil

(9:42) لَكِنْ بَعُدَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ الشُّقَّةُ but the distance was too far for them.

entries.label: شِقاق
entries.definitionHtml:
شِقاق shiqāq I [n.] schism, contention, heresy, rebellious disputation

(2:176) وَإِنَّ الَّذِينَ اخْتَلَفُوا فِى الْكِتَابِ لَفِي شِقَاقٍ بَعِيدٍ those who differ about the Scripture are in deep schism II [v. n.] separating, breaking up

(4:35) وَإِنْ خِفْتُمْ شِقَاقَ بَيْنِهِمَا فَابْعَثُوا حَكَمًا مِنْ أَهْلِهِ وَحَكَمًا مِنْ أَهْلِهَا and if you fear a split between the two, appoint one arbiter from his family and one from hers. * الإنشِقاق name of Sura 84, Meccan sura, so‐named because of the reference in verse

1 to ‘the Splitting’ of the sky.

entries.label: شِقّ
entries.definitionHtml:
شِقّ shiqq [n./v. n.] half; difficulty, hardship, distress *

(16:7) بِشِقِّ الأَنْفُسِ with extreme difficulty [lit. with splitting of the souls].
